# Tools360Pro

> Free online tools that run 100% in your browser — no sign-up, no uploads, no watermarks. 67 tools for PDF, images, AI, text, converters, calculators, developers and generators, plus step-by-step guides.

Tools360Pro is a free toolbox at https://tools360pro.com/. Every tool processes files locally in the visitor's browser, so documents, photos and text never leave their device. There are no accounts and no usage limits — the tools run locally, so nothing is counted or capped.

## PDF Tools

Merge, split and build PDFs. Category page: https://tools360pro.com/pdf-tools/

- [Merge PDF](https://tools360pro.com/tools/merge-pdf.html): Combine several PDF files into a single document.
- [Split PDF](https://tools360pro.com/tools/split-pdf.html): Extract a page range or split a PDF into separate files.
- [Images to PDF](https://tools360pro.com/tools/images-to-pdf.html): Turn JPG, PNG and WebP images into one PDF document.
- [JPG to PDF Converter](https://tools360pro.com/tools/jpg-to-pdf.html): Convert JPG images into one PDF — reorder pages, pick size and margins.
- [PDF to Image](https://tools360pro.com/tools/pdf-to-image.html): Render PDF pages as JPG or PNG images.
- [Rotate & Organize PDF](https://tools360pro.com/tools/rotate-pdf.html): Rotate, reorder and delete PDF pages.
- [Compress PDF](https://tools360pro.com/tools/compress-pdf.html): Shrink a PDF by re-encoding its images.
- [Sign PDF](https://tools360pro.com/tools/sign-pdf.html): Draw or type your signature and place it on any PDF page — no upload.
- [PDF to Word Converter](https://tools360pro.com/tools/pdf-to-word.html): Turn a text-based PDF into an editable Word document.

## Image Tools

Compress, resize and convert images. Category page: https://tools360pro.com/image-tools/

- [Compress Image](https://tools360pro.com/tools/compress-image.html): Reduce JPG, PNG and WebP file size with a quality slider.
- [Resize Image](https://tools360pro.com/tools/resize-image.html): Change image dimensions by pixels or percentage.
- [Convert Image](https://tools360pro.com/tools/convert-image.html): Convert images between JPG, PNG and WebP formats.
- [HEIC to JPG Converter](https://tools360pro.com/tools/heic-to-jpg.html): Convert iPhone HEIC photos to JPG or PNG, no uploads.
- [Crop Image](https://tools360pro.com/tools/crop-image.html): Crop images with a visual box and aspect presets.
- [Watermark Image](https://tools360pro.com/tools/watermark-image.html): Stamp text watermarks onto your images.
- [Favicon Generator](https://tools360pro.com/tools/favicon-generator.html): Generate favicon sizes and an ICO from one image.
- [Meme Generator](https://tools360pro.com/tools/meme-generator.html): Add top and bottom text to any image and download the meme.

Backgrounds, upscaling, OCR and more. Category page: https://tools360pro.com/ai-tools/

- [Background Remover](https://tools360pro.com/tools/background-remover.html): Remove image backgrounds with AI, right in your browser.
- [AI Image Upscaler](https://tools360pro.com/tools/ai-image-upscaler.html): Upscale images 2x or 4x with AI, right in your browser.
- [Image to Text (OCR)](https://tools360pro.com/tools/image-to-text.html): Extract text from images and scans with OCR, in your browser.
- [AI Audio Transcriber](https://tools360pro.com/tools/ai-transcriber.html): Transcribe audio and video to text with Whisper AI, in your browser.
- [AI Photo Enhancer](https://tools360pro.com/tools/ai-photo-enhancer.html): Sharpen photos and lift dull colours with AI, in your browser.
- [AI Object Remover](https://tools360pro.com/tools/ai-object-remover.html): Remove unwanted objects and people from photos with AI, in your browser.

## Text Tools

Count, convert and clean up text. Category page: https://tools360pro.com/text-tools/

- [Word Counter](https://tools360pro.com/tools/word-counter.html): Count words, characters, sentences and reading time.
- [Case Converter](https://tools360pro.com/tools/case-converter.html): Switch text between UPPER, lower, Title, camelCase and more.
- [Keyword Density Checker](https://tools360pro.com/tools/keyword-density.html): See how often words and phrases repeat in your text.
- [Meta Tag Generator](https://tools360pro.com/tools/meta-tag-generator.html): Build meta, Open Graph and Twitter Card tags with preview.
- [Lorem Ipsum Generator](https://tools360pro.com/tools/lorem-ipsum.html): Generate placeholder paragraphs, sentences or words.
- [Text Cleaner](https://tools360pro.com/tools/text-cleaner.html): Clean up text: extra spaces, line breaks, duplicates and accents.
- [Citation Generator](https://tools360pro.com/tools/citation-generator.html): Format APA, MLA, Chicago, Harvard, IEEE, Vancouver & Turabian references.
- [Text Summarizer](https://tools360pro.com/tools/text-summarizer.html): Shorten any text to its key sentences — extractive, free, no word limit.
- [Text to Handwriting Converter](https://tools360pro.com/tools/text-to-handwriting.html): Turn typed text into handwritten notebook pages.

## Developer Tools

JSON, Base64, JWT, CSS and regex. Category page: https://tools360pro.com/developer-tools/

- [JSON Formatter & Validator](https://tools360pro.com/tools/json-formatter.html): Format, minify and validate JSON with clear errors.
- [Base64 Encoder & Decoder](https://tools360pro.com/tools/base64.html): Encode and decode Base64 text and files, Unicode-safe.
- [UUID Generator](https://tools360pro.com/tools/uuid-generator.html): Generate random v4 UUIDs, one or in bulk.
- [URL & HTML Encoder](https://tools360pro.com/tools/url-encode.html): Encode and decode URLs and HTML entities.
- [JWT Decoder](https://tools360pro.com/tools/jwt-decoder.html): Inspect JWT headers and payloads in your browser.
- [CSS Gradient & Shadow Generator](https://tools360pro.com/tools/css-gradient-generator.html): Design gradients and box shadows with live preview.
- [Regex Tester](https://tools360pro.com/tools/regex-tester.html): Test regular expressions with highlighted matches.
- [Unix Timestamp Converter](https://tools360pro.com/tools/timestamp-converter.html): Convert Unix timestamps to dates and back, with a live clock.
- [Diff Checker](https://tools360pro.com/tools/diff-checker.html): Compare two texts line by line and highlight the changes.
- [Hash Generator](https://tools360pro.com/tools/hash-generator.html): Calculate MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256 and SHA-512 hashes.

- [Random Number Generator](https://tools360pro.com/tools/random-number-generator.html): Generate secure random numbers in any range, in bulk.
- [YouTube Thumbnail Downloader](https://tools360pro.com/tools/youtube-thumbnail-downloader.html): Download any YouTube video's thumbnail in HD and more sizes.
